overview: Arbormill Software is deploying an AI-powered agent-assist assistant embedded directly within Zendesk to support its support and escalation teams. The proposed solution leverages Google Cloud Platform to index knowledge bases and historical tickets, providing grounded reply drafting, automated ticket classification, and similar-ticket retrieval while strictly adhering to EU data residency and PII redaction requirements.

customer_objectives.text: Reduce average ticket handle time using AI-assisted drafting and search.
Lower the ticket re-routing rate through automated classification and routing.

solution_highlights.validation_reason: Customer did not state a cloud preference; GCP is recommended.
solution_highlights.text: Deploy a secure, EU-resident architecture on Google Cloud Platform using Vertex AI and Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform.
Embed a custom sidebar application within Zendesk to provide real-time agent assistance.
Implement grounded reply drafting with source citations and similar-ticket retrieval across Confluence, SharePoint, and historical tickets.
Enforce strict EU data residency, PII redaction, and zero third-party training on customer data.
